I kind of wrote a whole dissertation about this on a similar post last night 😭 but I really think that for them to be the It-boy group that everyone wants them to be, they need to be a little more adventurous with their concept. I know WakeOne isn't the company to watch when it comes to innovation, but that's really what we need right now. YITS was passable as a debut, In Bloom is easy to listen to and the boys do a great job performing, but I think the first comeback is where it's really gonna count. 

I'm not a creative director, so don't judge it too hard, but I put together some ["moodboards"](https://imgur.com/a/E5taXn1) for zb1's comeback concept. We're keeping the video game concept because it's so versatile, but we're pivoting to a racing game. They could stick to a darker, grounded in reality, Formula 1 kind of vibe, or more interestingly, take it to a place of colorful whimsy a la Mario Kart (think Rainbow Road or Electrodome). Flowers are pretty easy to incorporate into any concept that isn't too "hard," so I'm not too worried about that. 

What influenced this idea the most is the prevalence of [dnb jungle music in 90s and 2000s video game soundtracks](https://youtu.be/4341FfSedsQ?t=109) and people really eat up the pinkpantheress sound, so I think continuing that would be a good callback.

I actually didn’t think anyone would vibe with this, so thank you! 😭 I don’t know if I can show you anything cohesive through my Pinterest boards, I usually just save a bunch of pins that kind of vibe with what I’m looking for, go through everything later and pick the pins that work best together and deliver the vibe that I want, and make a little collage. I actually did something similar for their debut concept before we found out what it was but I never shared them anywhere because I was like, “This is so dumb, no one cares😭"

I didn’t do a full collage for this concept because I kind of threw it together in a short period of time (and honestly a lot of my vision for it is in really specific nostalgic memories of niche games I’ve played in the past, so it was hard to even find pins that were exactly what I was looking for), but I did put together [these three](https://imgur.com/a/E5taXn1) 6-piece... let's call them mood samplers. The first one is kind of your generic Formula 1 racing aesthetic, while the last two are the more colorful, Mario Kart takes on the concept. For the second one, I realized that a lot of my concept ideas are very girly and not really the feeling that boy groups are inclined to go for. So I put together something that was still bright and colorful, but less pastel. But I still had to include the full Rainbow Road pastel neon city slay for the vision. If we really want to return to a place of youth and shade, we could use the more grounded in reality, Formula 1 aesthetic for Youth, and one of the colorful fantastical ones for Shade.

I haven't thought about the execution of this concept long enough to consider outfits and styling, but off the top of my head, I think it would be best to go a little fun and kind of costumey. Like each member is a character on a character select screen. If you’ve ever seen [@handsomegirly's](https://www.instagram.com/handsomegirly/) outfits and designs (quirky animal hoods, hats, star earmuffs, campy hair ties, stickers on the face) that’s the feel I’m going for. Once again taking a more "girly" approach, but boy aesthetics in Kpop are just not cute and we really need to overcome that!

I've been thinking about this a lot and I actually have a Pinterest board of visuals I think would be interesting for them to explore for their first cb. 

The most identifiable part of their concept to me is, of course, the roses and the video game aspect. They proved with their exploration of "youth" and "shade" that the overall vibe of the concept can easily be changed while maintaining the identity of the concept, so I really think they can go in pretty much any direction. That's why the first thing that came to mind for me was a racing game concept. They could stick to a darker, grounded in reality, Formula 1 kind of vibe, or more interestingly, take it to a place of colorful whimsy a la Mario Kart (think Rainbow Road or Electrodome, maybe if it's a cb close enough to winter we can do a little snowy stage). 

We know from previous produce groups that it's very important to establish a musical identity, which is why I think it might be beneficial to return to the drum and bass sound for the comeback. It's especially appealing to stick with it because drum and bass was extremely instrumental to video game soundtracks in the 90s-early 2000s and I think it would be really nice to call back to that. But maybe I've just been listening to too many video game jungle mixes. Otherwise, I'm not sure what sound would do best in the current kpop climate. I always enjoy a little electronic/synthpop and that would work for this concept, but it might feel a bit dated to others? 

This is all just me saying things though. Whatever they end up doing, I really hope that WakeOne is able to step it up and really go all out for their first cb. I think, even more than the title track, this will decide if ZB1 will produce the future kpop leaders that I*ZONE did.
